review_candidates.title: Process Engineer – Power Plants
review_candidates.description_excerpt: - Review OEM and vendor deliverables against project specifications, applicable codes and Saudi utility requirements, and drive comments to closure. - Valid passport and readiness to travel to Saudi Arabia for project meetings and troubleshooting. But the projects are in the Kingdom, and the engineers who own the design go there — for design review meetings with the OEM, the EPC contractor and the client, and for troubleshooting when a system does not behave the way the drawings said it would. -
eligibility_evidence: - Based in Greater Cairo, or genuinely willing to relocate.
Trips are short and fully arranged and funded by the company: flights, accommodation, ground transport, visa and per diem.
- Prior work on Saudi projects: SEC / National Grid SA standards, Saudi Building Code, or Aramco specifications.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: - Review OEM and vendor deliverables against project specifications, applicable codes and Saudi utility requirements, and drive comments to closure. - Minimum 5 years of process/mechanical design experience, with at least 3 on power generation, substation or heavy industrial projects. 🏢 ABOUT US Bahrawy Consultancy Group is a multi-disciplinary Egyptian consultancy accredited as a "House of Expertise" — the highest ranking awarded to engineering consulting firms in Egypt — with an ISO-certified quality system and offices in Cairo, Riyadh and Jeddah.
